title: Claim
description: A single biological claim submitted to the firewall. This is the ONLY artifact an untrusted model may produce for verification. LLM prose is never verified directly.

schema_version.description: Semver of this schema the claim was written against. Bump on any incompatible change.

claim_id.description: Client-generated UUIDv4. The verifier uses it to key the verdict. Duplicates are refused at the ledger boundary.

relation.description: The relation the subject is asserted to have to the object. See spec/inference_rules.md for the evidence rule that governs each relation.

polarity.description: Explicit sign of the asserted effect. `none` is only valid for relations where sign is undefined (e.g. `binds`, `expressed_in`).

species.description: NCBI Taxonomy CURIE. The frozen ontology snapshot must contain this taxon.

cell_type.description: Cell Ontology CURIE (e.g. `CL:0000236`) or the literal string `unspecified`. `unspecified` bypasses cell-type matching but forces the claim's status to at most `hypothesis`.

cell_line.description: Cell-line CURIE (e.g. `CLO:0009454` for K562) or null. If present, the evidence must be recorded in the same cell line unless the inference rule waives it.

state.description: Free-text tag for developmental / stimulation / disease state (e.g. `resting`, `IFNG_stimulated`, `hypoxia_24h`). Compared to evidence.state by exact string equality; free-text mismatch triggers CONTEXT_MISMATCH unless waived by rule.

assay.description: Assay type (e.g. `scRNA-seq`, `bulk-RNA-seq`, `CRISPRi_screen`, `ChIP-seq`, `co-IP`). Governs which relations the evidence can license — see spec/inference_rules.md.

perturbation.description: Perturbation label if applicable (e.g. `CRISPRi:HGNC:1097`) or null. `causes` claims REQUIRE this to be non-null and to match an interventional evidence record.

evidence_ids.description: Source-record identifiers in the frozen evidence ledger. Every id must resolve; unresolved ids trigger BAD_CITATION. The empty list is invalid — the verifier does not verify unsupported claims.

confidence_language.description: How strongly the claim is worded. Mapped to an evidence-strength floor by spec/inference_rules.md. Overreach triggers UNSUPPORTED_CERTAINTY.

requested_status.description: The presentation tier the proposer wants the claim rendered at. `established` requires the strictest evidence rule; `hypothesis` is always available for supported claims.

id.description: CURIE in a known prefix (HGNC, ENSEMBL, UNIPROT, MONDO, CL, GO, CHEBI, REACT). Unknown prefix triggers UNKNOWN_ENTITY.

label.description: Human-readable label. Used only for rendering, never for identity. Label / id mismatch is a soft warning, not a fault.
